# Parley v0.1.62

This unnotarized test beta keeps agent commands working through sleep and
wake, fixes the command-run approval that failed on a closing quote, and
includes the remaining low findings of the 22 September repository review.

## No restart needed

The agent protocol is unchanged at version 33. Panes started under v0.1.61
keep working after the update.

## Agent commands through sleep and wake

- `parley wait` and other commands no longer fail with "stopped before
  replying" the moment the Mac wakes. A stale heartbeat now wakes Parley's
  transport and is waited out for about five seconds. A clock stepping back
  no longer stops heartbeats, and no longer makes a stopped Parley look
  alive to a waiting command.
- A reply or a half-written request caught by a long sleep is kept, so
  `parley wait` no longer polls forever for a reply that was removed at wake.
- A command reading slow input from stdin no longer loses its request after
  30 seconds, and Ctrl-C or a tool timeout cleans up at once. If Parley's
  coordination restarts, a waiting command says so instead of waiting
  forever.
- Endpoints of restarted panes are removed, so a long session no longer
  accumulates them.

## Handoffs and delivery

- Approving a command run no longer fails with "The data couldn't be read
  because it isn't in the correct format": the argument editor turned a
  closing `"` into `”`. Every box whose text is approved or sent now has
  smart quotes and other substitutions off and keeps its own undo, and the
  argument preview shows `/` as written.
- Retry Delivery is offered only when nothing reached the pane. A delivery
  that failed after its text was pasted was offered as a safe retry and
  could paste the text twice.
- A voice send refused before any input (Copilot folder trust not yet
  confirmed, or another delivery still in progress) keeps the draft open to
  send again, instead of offering only copy or discard.
- A failed send of an agent's context draft keeps your edits. They reopen
  for sending, or, if the agent changed the draft meanwhile, are offered to
  copy.
- Context packs: an agent's staged file can no longer forge a part boundary
  or a metadata line; a Git diff too large to capture whole is refused rather
  than cut; a command killed by a signal says which signal.

## Teams and containers

- A team member whose container failed to prepare now reads as stopped and
  is offered by Close stopped team panes. Pressing Stop while a container is
  still being prepared reports a cancelled preparation, not a failed stop.
- A lead working at `/` can create team panes; they were approved and then
  refused.
- Checking a container image and switching vendor before it finishes no
  longer applies the first vendor's result.
- A pane restarted while its lost container client was being cleaned up
  keeps its new session.
- Removing a container asks Docker for the daemon's identity once rather
  than before every step.

## Responsiveness

- Status Center builds its view once per change instead of about twenty
  times per draw, and skips its two-second history read when nothing
  changed.
- Review Changes reads the repository off the main thread.
- A shell reporting its folder at every prompt no longer rewrites Parley's
  state file each time.
- A helper command that times out now ends everything it started. The
  launch-time PATH lookup no longer stalls for six seconds when Parley is
  run from a terminal.

## Other fixes

- Parley's private files are created readable only by you and are synced
  before they replace the old copy. A crash or power loss mid-write could
  leave a file that the next launch refused.
- A failed history compaction no longer stops later handoffs from being
  recorded, and context reviews still in use are never pruned.
- The launch review no longer hangs on, or reads whole, a FIFO or huge file
  placed in a project's `.claude` settings.
- An approved run that starts just as Parley checks on it is no longer
  failed with "do not resend".
- Switching update channel during a release check no longer shows the other
  channel's result.
- Imported Ghostty appearance keeps the primary font family when several are
  listed.
- Move and Prepare to Uninstall check every active handoff.
- For development: `npm run dev:restart-protocol` is removed; it could never
  restart anything, because every agent pane is stopped at launch.

## Validation and known limits

The release workflow repeats the deterministic checks, repository scans,
the app build, the 25-round Ghostty soak, packaging, checksums and
packaged-launch verification before publishing this beta.

Checked in code and automated checks but not yet by hand in the app: the
command-run argument editor with real quotes, keys typed during an approved
run, a voice send to an untrusted Copilot pane, and Stop while a team
container is being prepared. A command started just as the Mac goes to
sleep can still be refused after wake, because its short-lived relay ticket
has expired; run it again.

This is an ad-hoc-signed, unnotarized test beta. It does not update the
stable Sparkle feed or Homebrew cask. Follow the included installation
instructions.
